summary: Frontend-only e2e test of new LanguagePrompt component on PulseFitness.ai login page. Verified all 6 core scenarios pass: French prompt appears with correct copy, one-tap switch flips i18nextLng to 'fr' and sets pf_lang_prompt_seen='1' and dismisses card, does-not-nag on reload, German path shows German copy and switches to 'de', dismiss/decline path closes card and keeps English while setting seen flag, and no prompt appears when browser locale already matches the active UI language.
critical_code_review_comments: LanguagePrompt.jsx correctly uses SEEN_KEY='pf_lang_prompt_seen', target-language copy for FR/DE, 1.2s delay useEffect, data-testids: language-prompt, language-prompt-accept, language-prompt-dismiss, language-prompt-decline — all present and functional.
accept() persists to /api/account/profile only when user+token present, non-blocking (try/catch swallowed) — acceptable; UI switch happens first via i18n.changeLanguage + localStorage set.
Guard `if (active === browser) return;` correctly prevents nagging when already matched.
Minor: The prompt sits at z-[300] bottom-left; the CookieConsent banner sits bottom-center and does not overlap. Verified visually — no z-index conflict.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LanguagePrompt covered by anonymous flows only. Signed-in persistence path (owner@isodemo.com PATCH /api/account/profile language=fr) not executed in this iteration to avoid mutating the demo account; the network call is wrapped in try/catch and non-blocking so failure would not surface visibly. If needed, wire a request assertion via page.wait_for_request and always revert with PATCH language='en' cleanup.
